posts.title: Elderflower syrup
posts.description: Ingredients Fresh elderflower (Holunderblüte) 1 kg or 1 l water 1 kg sugar 1 lemon, sliced Preparation Collecting Find an elder tree in full bloom. Mid-June is usually the right time. They’re everywhere and they’re easy to spot. Collect 15-25 flowers, only getting a few cuttings per tree.
